posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
Excellent work Tony, Excellent!!!

It's so fantastic to see someone else put forth so much effort in DCG and take the time to share it with us all. You keep posting and ask any questions you want. The whole is greater then the sum of it's parts. 

That last coins hologram definetly shows silvers, golds, coppers and brass. Too totally cool and it confirms what we started on the other thread. So now we need to continue to discuss why this is. Why is it that we get natural colors of metal based solely on the amount their reflectivity? We have to remember these are all shot with a single wavelength.

Might you want to put the single new "coins" hologram from this thread in the other thread so we can view it and continue our discussion?

This is totally awsome! I hope I don't get you to fall into the same "fun testing trap" I love to do with DCG. I have so many to hang on walls that I found a couple of years ago, the real fun is finding out all the hidden secrets DCG has to offer. But anyway, thank you again for your effort in this. I am sure when we uncover the mysteries, we will take anther great step to understanding fully this great medium and realize it's full potential.

posts.author: Dutchelm05
posts.content_md:
Thanks guys for the encouragement.

I enjoy testing when it leads to a better understanding of what I am doing. Being in the elementry school of DCG it should be required of all students 

Part of this was understanding exposure parameters. Although I understood the basic effects of exposure time and color by reading about it, I did know by how much. I appears with this set of objects it is +/- 20% exposure time in seeing noticeable effects, with the optimal exposure time most likely +/- 10%. 

Last week I also did gel thickness testing where I used Danny B's suggestion of 3 plys of tape on one side of my mold and 1 ply on the other (5"X12"). I will post those results later.

This week, I want to do some fixer testing and H20 bath testing.

John and Joe, I hope you have time to read my post on H2O bath, I would very much like your input. Dave posted something already that was fairly insightful. I was worried it would get buried if I posted too many things.

John, if there is something you would like me to try please ask, I will add it to my testing. How about psuedo-metals?
